english.note: Use this when emphasizing that the past action happened frequently or repeatedly, rather than merely happening as a former routine.

examples.english: I used to binge-watch dramas at night and only get up the next day.
examples.traditional: 我以前成日夜晚煲劇，第二日先起身。
